title: Info in slot
description: Displays tooltip stats inside item slots. Made for Economy servers like DonutSMP, Rainyday, Hypixel. Configurable!
body:
Mod was inspired by Map in Slot mod & DonutSMP Server (Drill Timer)

This mod extracts information from the Tooltip without the need to hover mouse over it, then it displays those stats inside the inventory hotbar Slot (many configuration options)

1.2.0 Release

- Self Destruct or Expire Timer
- Auction or Order Item Price
- Order Delivered Count (for personal orders)
- Order Count available to be Delivered (for other player orders)
information is obtain by taking the order request count and subtracting it by the already delivered count for example  25/100 Delievered would Display as 75

Configuration Options:
Ability to change
- Color
- Bold Font
- Text Size (Small, Medium, (Large for Timer only))
- Toggle Background (dark gray square behind text)
- Position (Top, Middle, Bottom)
for all 4 Categories 
Timer Display
Auciton Price
Order Price
Order Display

also includes Color Seperator option for Expiration Timer
2+Days, Day, Hours, Minutes
Magenta, Aqua, Gold, Red

all can be changed either thru (Mod Menu) or thru Commands for those who arent using Mod Menu
or just want to quickly type it out
/slotinfo

Control Keybinds
- Toggle Mod on & Off (unbound)
- Cycle Timer Size (unbound) 
when keybind pressed cycles Expire Timer character size beween Small, Medium, Large
- Toggle Hours only (h)
converts times like 2d 20h to 68h

1.3.0 Update

- Buy & Sell display
- Chance Display w Fraction Mode
- Shards Currency Display (for DonutSMP)
- Coins Currency Display (Hypixel Compatible)
- Gems Currency Display
- Rubies Currency Display
- Main Config Clean with Universal Toggles
- changed command tree start to /infoinslot
- Toggleable Stats Display in Inventory/Hotbar/Container

New Keybinds
- Toggle All backgrounds
- Toggle Fraction Mode (chance display) 5% or 1/20

1.4.0 Update

- Added Display Outlines for All Displays (better clean alternative against backgrounds) 
Added Rainyday.gg Server Support displaying Information such as
- Cloud Coins as Currency
- Special Items Display Detecting [Special] from Item name then by Default Displaying "SP" in Gold change config (rainyday category) if you want it to say "Special"
- Scale Levels displays in the Center
- Scale Type 2 Letter Abbreviation Example Dungeoneer +75 = Du+75  (default off) 
- Scale Type Abbreviation letters color change
- added a json file to store Scale names and Max Level Values and color (future proof if server changes! Easily changeable for players) (file generates if 1.4.0+ mod was loaded)
located in:     AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\config\infoinslot_scales.json
- Display Timer was turned off by Default (turn on using /infoinslot) or mod menu config
- Fixed Display in Inventory when outside container not showing info in slot
- Fix Hotbar Display not showing info in slot
